description.value:
The hype thrall has no independent turns, actions, reactions, Strikes, or spells. Command Flash Mob grants support only, not the usual two minion actions. The thrall is stationary unless another ability moves it.

Attacks automatically hit the thrall, and it automatically fails all saving throws. It has 1 HP, is destroyed at 0 HP, and does not use dying rules. It can flank but cannot Strike.

Special The thrall grants no separate XP.

The thrall's space is difficult terrain, but other creatures can enter it as though it were unoccupied. A creature entering its space can automatically push the thrall into an adjacent space outside that creature's path.

speed.details: Stationary unless explicitly commanded; support commands grant no movement.

details.blurb: Disposable applause and encouragement; no independent turns.
details.publicNotes: A one-hit-point, bard-like support prop created by Flash Mob. This custom thrall uses a level-18 scaling shell and grants no separate encounter XP. It has no independent turns, Strikes, or spells. Its one-minute expiration marker is supplied when summoned.
details.privateNotes:
Derived from PF2e Summons Assistant's built-in Thrall. Preserve the thrall actor trait for the helper's self:trait:thrall predicate. Runtime adds summoner linkage, owner actor/token UUIDs, creation nonce, and the expiration marker without generating strikes. Do not add this token to initiative as an independent enemy.

Foundry Operating Notes

Support Shell

This is a disposable support minion, not a real bard or a separate level-18 enemy. Level 18 is a scaling shell for the summoning integration; AC and saving-throw values are placeholders. Retain the helper thrall's immunities and summoner linkage.

At 0 HP, remove its token; it no longer qualifies for support or the live cap. Automatic runtime cleanup occurs after 1 minute, not immediately at 0 HP. Command Flash Mob chooses one living own thrall within 60 feet and gives a benefit only to Blaster.

Yield the Stage

This forced displacement does not grant the thrall an independent move or a support command.
